change_summary: The paper has been retracted after the authors found a coding error in the analysis. The coding error invalidates the main result, and the reported 2.1% increase in bone density was not reproducible. The stored paper's abstract reports that 1000 IU daily vitamin D raised hip bone density by 2.1% over a year.
evaluation: No draft was uploaded, so this judgment is general and assumes a typical researcher who cites the paper as key evidence. The paper has been retracted after the authors found a coding error in the analysis that invalidates the main result. The reported 2.1% increase in bone density was not reproducible, so the impact on a researcher relying on it as key evidence would be high.
recommendation: The paper has been retracted after the authors found a coding error in the analysis that invalidates the main result, and the reported 2.1% increase in bone density was not reproducible. No draft was uploaded. Upload your draft for this project so the next change can be judged against it, since without it we can't tell which parts are affected. Meanwhile, if you cite this paper as evidence, remove or replace the citation and re-check the claim it supported; if your own methods or data depend on it, raise it with your co-authors or supervisor.
